items.title: Sheryl Bailey interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 24, 2023

ctx.x: Guitarist Sheryl Bailey transitioned from heavy metal to jazz after hearing Wes Montgomery on the radio. She fashioned a career in New York, frequently collaborating with Gary Versace, Ian Froman, and Harvie S. She is on the faculty at Berklee College of Music.
Sheryl was interviewed via Zoom on July 24, 2023 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
